name: Varek Prismshot
exported_coordinate_units: centimeters in independent temporary copies; source metres

textures.Normal: linear tangent; shallow low-frequency scale swatch
textures.ORM: linear R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

source_brief.silhouette: A long narrow torso with a broad prismatic bow and two short outward horn fins. A split short cloak creates a forked shape without actual wings.
source_brief.face: Blue-gray scales, pale gold eyes and a short angular muzzle. Horn fins are blunt and clearly part of the head rather than a wearable crown.
source_brief.costume: Dark blue fitted ranger coat, ivory shoulder panels, silver belt and practical boots. The cloak ends at the hips.
source_brief.palette: Blue gray #7996AC; deep blue #3F567A; ivory #E6DFC9; prism cyan #8BC9CA.
source_brief.equipment: A stylized bow with broad translucent-looking but opaque shaded crystal facets. Keep its central grip readable and its mechanics decorative.
source_brief.signature: Prismatic horizontal bow, short horn fins and forked cloak.
source_brief.materials: Opaque faceted crystal shader, matte scale surface and soft cloth. Refraction is not required for the crystal look.
source_brief.back: Cloak panels suggest folded wings in outline only; no hidden wing rig or flight ability. A flat quiver sits between them.
source_brief.animation: Idle holds the bow low. Basics release pale magic arrows. The active rotates the bow slightly to align its facets, then fires one clear beamlike projectile with finite travel time.
source_brief.vfx: One narrow cyan projectile and compact prismatic target sparkle. It does not pierce, chain or deal true damage.
source_brief.audio: A crystalline bow note and a short clean impact, mixed below large area spells.
source_brief.risk: Crystal materials can become too bright against snowlike backgrounds. Keep dark facet planes and verify readability without bloom.

equipment: Visual only; Broad horizontal opaque prism bow with dark central grip and a readable second-hand draw; hip-length forked cloak and flat rear quiver.
open_reviews: muzzle crest armor and weapon clearance
